s0.ru: Потенциал в {n} точках: {values}. Разность точки равна правому соседу минус левый. Соседа за краем нет, он равен 0. Какова разность последней точки?
s0.en: The potential has {n} points: {values}. The difference at a point is the right neighbor minus the left neighbor. A neighbor beyond an edge is absent and equals 0. What is the difference at the last point?

s1.en: The potential has {n} points: {values}. The difference at a point is the right neighbor minus the left neighbor. A neighbor beyond an edge is absent and equals 0. What is the sum of the squares of all differences?
